analisis: Suplemento dietario en cápsulas de la marca Vitalabh, con aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, más vitaminas A y E. Es un nutracéutico para mujeres que quieren acompañar su proceso de curvas sin cirugía. Frasco negro de 60 cápsulas (un mes, 2 al día), con tapa y franja de abajo en rosado fucsia y letras blancas y rosadas.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type.

datos.publico: mujeres que quieren más volumen en glúteos y piernas
datos.adicional: 20 variaciones de su anuncio ganador (antes y después estilo animado 3D, fondo morado oscuro a la izquierda y rosado a la derecha, titular grande blanco y amarillo, notas escritas a mano, sello dorado, íconos abajo) para AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1. Tanda 1 de 2.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Adapted from the winning reference to the bottle colors, same contrast and hierarchy: BEFORE panel in deep plum-black #2A0E22 (dark, desaturated, with soft vignette); AFTER panel in vivid hot fuchsia #E6177F glowing to bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 in the center, with deep magenta #B0105E shading at the edges. Headline in pure white #FFFFFF alternating with warm sunshine yellow #FFD23F. Seal in black #0E0E10 with metallic gold #D4A437 rim, stars and big text. Handwritten notes, subtitle, icons and icon labels in white.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Stylized 3D animated cartoon render (glossy, soft-shaded, big expressive eyes, smooth skin) in a split-screen before/after ad, exactly like the winning reference: same woman in both panels, the change of the body clearly visible, real product photo composited large in the bottom-right corner.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Left side gloomy, quiet and insecure; right side bright, warm, sparkling, confident and feminine.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Rounded pill labels at the top of each panel, a thick white curved arrow crossing from the BEFORE panel into the AFTER panel, white casual handwritten notes with small hand-drawn arrows, a scribble doodle and small outline hearts, four-point white sparkles, a large soft pink flower behind the product, a round black-and-gold seal with three small stars and a shield-check, and a bottom row of three thin-line white icons with short labels.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Same as the winning reference: headline in an ultra-heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / Archivo Black look), ALL CAPS, very tight leading, left-aligned, alternating white and yellow lines with a soft dark drop shadow; subtitle in a clean rounded sans-serif (Poppins Medium look), white, sentence case; side notes in a casual white marker handwriting script; panel pills and seal in bold sans-serif caps; icon labels in small regular sans-serif, sentence case, centered.
identidad_visual.art_direction: Keep the winning reference's composition, blocks and type exactly; only the headline changes between variations. The product is always the real bottle from the photo, sharp, large and readable. Clean backgrounds without noise, everything readable on a phone.
